hints.title: Count Digits of Each Number
hints.text: For each integer in nums, determine the total count of digits in its base 10 representation.

hints.title: Check Parity of Digit Count
hints.text: A number has an even number of digits if its digit count is divisible by 2.

hints.title: Single Pass Counter
hints.text: Iterate through all numbers, determine digit length via string conversion or log10, and accumulate count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full parsing of strings is slightly slower than arithmetic ranges but asymptotically linear.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Can check ranges directly (e.g. 10..99, 1000..9999) for zero memory overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles digit counting or string length conversion cleanly.
complexity.notes: Given nums[i] <= 10^5, even digit ranges are 10..99, 1000..9999, 100000.
